title: Adaptive strict finalize v2r—30s segments, dK=8, artifact save (20 min)
abstract: v2r with 30s segments, smaller frontier growth (dK=8), and robust feasibility projector each segment and at finish. Saves NPZ artifact for reproducibility. Deterministic.

original_submission.content:
import os, time, numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import active_quench_adaptive as AD

def construct_packing():
    C, r, S = AD.adaptive_finalize(
        total_sec=1200.0,
        seed=20251209,
        segment_sec=30.0,
        eta_S=5e-6,
        eta_slack=1e-7,
        gamma_alpha=0.6,
        dK=8,
        k_pairs_init=176,
        alpha0_init=1.2e-4,
        boundary_push_init=0.64,
        boundary_push_min=0.58,
        pair_margin=5e-12,
        boundary_margin=2e-12
    )
    # Save artifact for reproducibility
    runs_dir = os.path.join("storage", "noesis", "pack", "runs")
    os.makedirs(runs_dir, exist_ok=True)
    score = float(np.sum(r))
    ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", time.gmtime())
    np.savez(os.path.join(runs_dir, f"polished_adapt_v2r30_dK8_{ts}_S{score:.6f}.npz"),
             centers=C.astype(float), radii=r.astype(float), score=score)
    # Minimal validity checks
    assert C.shape == (26,2) and r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r > 0)
    return C, r
